LanguageData.CK_DrawWaterBottle.label: Draw mineral water
LanguageData.CK_DrawWaterBottle.description: Fill one 1 L bottle of mineral water at this water spot. No bucket or basin needed.
LanguageData.CK_DrawWaterBucket.label: Draw water (bucket)
LanguageData.CK_DrawWaterBucket.description: Fill one 60 L water bucket at this water spot. Needs an empty or partly filled bucket.
LanguageData.CK_DrawWaterBulk.label: Bulk draw water
LanguageData.CK_DrawWaterBulk.description: Bring up to 5 empty buckets to this water spot and fill them in one trip.
